title: Senior Python Backend Engineer — AI Products
description: We are building a next-generation AI-powered document intelligence platform used by engineering firms across Central Asia. The backend team owns the core API layer, LLM integration pipelines, and data infrastructure. You will design and ship features end-to-end: from database schema and async FastAPI services to prompt engineering and vector search. We work in a small, senior team — everyone owns their domain and deploys to production multiple times a week. Stack: FastAPI, PostgreSQL + pgvector, Redis, Kafka, Docker, Yandex Cloud.
requirements: 5+ years of commercial Python development. Deep FastAPI and SQLAlchemy (async) experience. Hands-on with at least one LLM provider API (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) in production. Experience with vector databases or pgvector for semantic search. PostgreSQL performance tuning, indexing, query optimisation. Redis for caching and distributed locking. Kafka or another message broker for async pipelines. Docker and Docker Compose for local dev and deployment. Strong grasp of REST API design, Pydantic v2, async/await patterns. English or Russian — either is fine.

title: NLP / ML Engineer — Multilingual Text Processing
description: Our data team processes millions of documents per month in Russian, Kazakh, and English — contracts, regulatory filings, news articles, and user-generated content. We need an engineer who can own the full NLP pipeline: from raw text ingestion and language detection through entity extraction, classification, and embedding-based retrieval. You will work closely with product and backend teams to ship ML features into production, not just notebooks. We use spaCy, HuggingFace Transformers, sentence-transformers, and scikit-learn. Comfort with Python backend basics (FastAPI or Flask) is a plus.
requirements: 3+ years in NLP engineering or applied ML with a focus on text. Solid experience with spaCy (custom pipelines, NER, PhraseMatcher). HuggingFace Transformers — fine-tuning and inference (BERT, XLM-RoBERTa, or similar). Sentence-transformers / SBERT for semantic similarity and embedding-based retrieval. scikit-learn: TF-IDF, classification, clustering. Experience with multilingual models — Russian and/or Kazakh is a strong plus. Ability to evaluate models properly: precision, recall, F1, AUC. Basic Python API development (Flask or FastAPI). Git, Docker.

title: Middle Python Developer — FinTech Backend
description: We run a digital lending platform processing tens of thousands of loan applications per day. Our backend is a set of Python microservices handling scoring, payments, notifications, and KYC. You will own one or more of these services — writing new features, fixing bugs, reviewing peers' code, and participating in on-call rotation. The role is backend-heavy with some data work: integrating ML scoring models, building ETL jobs, and maintaining Kafka consumers. No ML research required — the data science team hands off models; you integrate and monitor them.
requirements: 3+ years of Python backend development. Django or FastAPI — we use both; comfort with either is enough. PostgreSQL — schema design, migrations (Alembic or Django migrations), query optimisation. Redis — caching, rate limiting, session management. Celery for background jobs and scheduling. Kafka or RabbitMQ — consumer/producer experience. REST API design and integration. Docker. Understanding of fintech concepts: idempotency, state machines for loan lifecycle, payment reconciliation. Russian language required for internal communication.

title: DevOps / MLOps Engineer — AI Infrastructure
description: We are scaling our AI platform from a handful of research services to a production system handling thousands of inference requests per minute. We need an engineer who can bridge classic DevOps (Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability) with ML-specific concerns: model versioning, GPU node management, inference serving, and experiment tracking. You will own the infrastructure that data scientists and backend engineers deploy onto — making deployments boring and reliable. Stack: Kubernetes (EKS or k3s), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Prometheus + Grafana, MLflow, Docker.
requirements: 4+ years in DevOps or platform engineering. Kubernetes — production cluster management, Helm, autoscaling, resource quotas. Terraform for infrastructure as code. CI/CD pipelines — GitHub Actions or GitLab CI. Prometheus, Grafana, Loki or similar observability stack. Docker and container best practices. Kafka or managed streaming service (ops experience, not necessarily development). MLOps concepts: model registry, experiment tracking (MLflow or similar), inference serving (Triton, BentoML, or similar). Python scripting for automation. AWS, GCP, or Yandex Cloud.

title: Full-Stack Python + React Engineer — Internal AI Tools
description: We build internal productivity tools for a 500-person company: AI-powered search, document summarisation, HR automation, and a recruiter assistant. The team is two engineers — you will work across the full stack, owning both the FastAPI backend and the React frontend. ML integration is a big part of the job: wrapping LLM APIs, building RAG pipelines, and creating Streamlit or React dashboards for business users. This role suits someone who is comfortable being a generalist and shipping things fast rather than specialising deeply.
requirements: 3+ years of Python backend (FastAPI or Django). At least 1 year of React or Vue — enough to build functional, clean UIs without a dedicated frontend engineer. LLM API integration experience (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or HuggingFace). Streamlit for internal dashboards is a strong plus. PostgreSQL and Redis basics. Docker. REST API design. Good product sense — you will talk directly to business stakeholders to define requirements. Russian language required. Nice to have: spaCy or sentence-transformers, n8n or similar workflow automation.
